items.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: I guess so, yeah, and with Cannonball.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well I liked his earlier things, before he got into the “sheets of sound” and like that. When he would join Miles in 1955 and I heard that band, I just nearly came out of my skin.
I guess so, yeah, and with Cannonball.
No this was just the quintet.
